blogs.title: Beyond Weight Loss: Pharmacovigilance for Emerging GLP-1 Receptor Agonists
blogs.description: Explore the expanding safety profile of GLP-1 RAs like semaglutide, moving beyond GI effects to consider emerging signals of myopathy and autoimmune risks. Discuss the importance of vigilance in high-volume metabolic medication prescribing.

blogs.title: When Antibodies Fail: Managing Seronegative Immune-Mediated Necrotising Myopathy
blogs.description: Analyze the clinical challenges presented by seronegative patients (negative HMGCR/SRP). Review the utility of muscle biopsy histology and the implications of a 'dark diagnosis' where standard autoantibody panels return negative.

blogs.title: Time Course Over Peak Levels: Differentiating IMNM from Acute Rhabdomyolysis
blogs.description: A critical look at how CK trajectory over time distinguishes drug-induced necrotizing myopathy (progressive over 4+ months) from acute toxic rhabdomyolysis (resolving rapidly). Use serial lab trends as a diagnostic tool rather than a single value.

blogs.title: Occult Dysphagia: A Red Flag for Myopathy in Patients with Metabolic Disease
blogs.description: Discuss the clinical presentation of the dysphagia-weakness triad in patients with obesity and fatty liver. Highlight common diagnostic traps where dysphagia is attributed to GERD or functional issues before invasive evaluation.

blogs.title: The Critical Role of Drug Cessation in Managing Drug-Induced Myositis
blogs.description: Examine the unique management principle that prompts immediate discontinuation of the offending agent in drug-induced IMNM. Compare the treatment course for drug-triggered cases against idiopathic inflammatory myopathies regarding duration and steroid burden.
